verdict.rationale: Linear's rate-limiting docs publish exact per-auth request limits (2,500/hr for API keys, 5,000 for OAuth apps, 600/IP unauthenticated). They also cover leaky-bucket refill, complexity limits, and X-RateLimit response headers, and say higher limits can be requested from support. That lets an automation builder know the documented ceilings before scaling. Missing for 10: an explicit concurrency cap (no simultaneous-request or connection limit is documented beyond the hourly and complexity limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale

citations.quote: API key — 2,500 requests per User per 1 hour; OAuth App — 5,000 per User; Unauthenticated — 600 per IP Address
X-RateLimit-Requests-Limit — The maximum number of API requests you're permitted to make per hour.
If you temporarily require higher limits, you can request them by contacting Linear support where we'll review them on a case by case basis.
